nodes.title: SG-11.1 Phaser scene listens for playAnimation on the event bus
nodes.body:
Context: ReactToPhaserEvents already declares playAnimation { target, name } in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts, but nothing in BootScene subscribes to reactToPhaser. Desired behavior: the scene plays the target character's idle or interact animation when the event arrives and releases the subscription when the scene shuts down. Why: React game actions (SG-11) need to drive character animations.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a created BootScene, when reactToPhaser emits playAnimation {target:'boy', name:'interact'}, then the boy sprite plays its interact animation key
- Given a created BootScene, when playAnimation {name:'idle'} is emitted, then the target sprite plays its idle animation key
- Given the scene has shut down, when playAnimation is emitted, then no sprite play call is made


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts subscription and character animation dispatch
- Out of scope: Emitting playAnimation from App
- Out of scope: transitionTo handling
- Out of scope: New events or content changes
- Preserve: Existing characterClick interact-then-idle behavior
- Preserve: Existing shutdown cleanup
- Preserve: Typed event bus API


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Use reactToPhaser from events.ts; no new bus
- Reuse resolveCharacterAnimation and ensureAnim


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have passing unit tests
- Existing bootScene tests still pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene plays the matching character animation on playAnimation
nodes.body:
Context: createCharacter in BootScene.ts (L105-L128) builds sprites but keeps no id lookup, and create() (L63-L85) never subscribes to reactToPhaser. Desired behavior: on playAnimation, find the character by id and play the resolved animation; interact returns to idle on completion. Unknown targets or names are ignored.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given target 'boy' and name 'interact', when playAnimation is emitted, then sprite.play is called with the interact key
- Given target 'boy' and name 'idle', when emitted, then sprite.play is called with the idle key
- Given an unknown target id, when emitted, then no play call occurs and nothing throws


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene character lookup by id
- In scope: playAnimation handler
- Out of scope: App emitting the event
- Preserve: Click behavior in createCharacter


## Technical constraints
- Name limited to CharacterAnimationName values


## Definition of done
- Handler implemented in BootScene


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene releases the playAnimation subscription on shutdown
nodes.body:
Context: the SHUTDOWN handler in create() (L73-L83) releases keyboard, store, effects and objects. Desired behavior: the playAnimation unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on is also called there, so a stopped scene never touches destroyed sprites.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when playAnimation is emitted, then sprite.play is not called
- Given the scene is running, when SHUTDOWN has not run, then the handler count on playAnimation is one


## Scope
- In scope: Unsubscribe in SHUTDOWN handler
- Out of scope: Other event cleanup
- Preserve: Existing cleanup order and behavior


## Technical constraints
- Use the unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on


## Definition of done
- Unsubscribe stored and called on shutdown


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Subscribe BootScene to playAnimation and dispatch to character sprites
nodes.body:
Add a character lookup map, a playCharacterAnimation method, and subscribe to reactToPhaser playAnimation in create().

## Acceptance criteria
- playAnimation with target 'boy' name 'interact' calls play with the interact key
- Unknown target is ignored without throwing


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: Shutdown unsubscribe
- Preserve: characterClick behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- BootScene handles playAnimation for known characters


## Clarifying questions
- None
nodes.summary: Track characters by id and play resolved animations on playAnimation
nodes.description: Add a character lookup map, a playCharacterAnimation method, and subscribe to reactToPhaser playAnimation in create().
acceptance_criteria: playAnimation with target 'boy' name 'interact' calls play with the interact key
Unknown target is ignored without throwing
definition_of_done: BootScene handles playAnimation for known characters

steps.action: Import reactToPhaser alongside phaserToReact from './events'; import type CharacterAnimationName from '@game/engine/characterAnimation'; add private fields characterAnims (Map<string, {sprite, spec, idleKey, interactKey}>) and unsubscribeAnimation ((() => void) | null).
steps.expected: File type-checks with the new fields

steps.action: Before `return sprite`, register the sprite: this.characterAnims.set(spec.id, { sprite, spec }).
steps.expected: Every created character is findable by spec.id

steps.action: Add private method playCharacterAnimation(target: string, name: string): returns if target missing or name not in ['idle','walk','interact']; resolves ref with resolveCharacterAnimation(spec, name as CharacterAnimationName, manifest), key via this.ensureAnim(ref.asset, ref.animation); returns if key null; sprite.play(key); for non-idle names, once ANIMATION_COMPLETE plays the idle key from ensureAnim of the idle ref.
steps.expected: Method plays the resolved key and ignores unknown targets

steps.action: After characterSprites is assigned, subscribe: this.unsubscribeAnimation = reactToPhaser.on('playAnimation', ({ target, name }) => this.playCharacterAnimation(target, name)).
steps.code: this.unsubscribeAnimation = reactToPhaser.on('playAnimation', ({ target, name }) => this.playCharacterAnimation(target, name));
steps.expected: Emitting playAnimation on reactToPhaser reaches playCharacterAnimation
